== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' (not an official image) of the Virtual Legacy card [[The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett (Errata)]] — version PC-E1 of •The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett (Virtual Block 8.1, later retitled [[Jango Fett, The Assassin|Jango Fett, The Assassin]]).

No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 8.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-01-Jango_Fett_The_Assassin.png]]) prints the original text ([[The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett]]), and the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-9-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-jangofetttheassassin-pre.gif]]) print the current card ([[Jango Fett, The Assassin]]).

Text source: Players Committee website card list, VBlock8Type as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 21 July 2012] and VMasterType as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012] to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the card list writes the icons as words, the icons here are the printed ones.

PC-E1 text: “[Pilot] 3. Adds one battle destiny. SD-17 Homing Missile may deploy on (and is a matching weapon for) him, fires for free, and when fired may go to lost pile instead. While piloting Slave I with Boba (unless your [Virtual Block 4] objective on table), it is immune to attrition <9.” Title •The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett, lore “Trade Federation assassin and scout.” as on the release-sheet slip. The frame is CardMaker's plain Dark character frame (the printed card has a red-shaded frame).

Made: 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (rev 73), from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (PC card image art). Not an official image.

* Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
